fields.name: birthDate
fields.description: Original birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to determine the natal longitude of the selected planet.

fields.name: birthTime
fields.description: Original birth time in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format. Determines exact natal planet position for return timing.

fields.name: planet
fields.description: Planet for the return calculation. Supports Mercury (~88 days), Venus (~225 days), Mars (~687 days), Jupiter (~12 years), and Saturn (~29 years). Saturn return is a major life milestone in Western astrology.

fields.name: approximateDate
fields.description: Approximate date near the expected planetary return (YYYY-MM-DD). The return nearest this date is returned, so a date off by months still lands on a genuine return; during a retrograde loop the planet crosses its natal degree up to three times and the crossing nearest the date is the one returned.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the return location in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Affects house cusps and Ascendant of the return chart.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the return location in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Decimal hours from UTC OR IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York"). IANA resolved to the DST-correct offset for the birthDate. Output datetime is adjusted to this timezone.

fields.name: houseSystem
fields.description: House system for the return chart. Placidus (default), Whole Sign, Equal, or Koch.
